# Smuggling Prevention
As a marine in the TSFMC, part of your job is to prevent the smuggling of Phaethon Dynasty supply crates.
Smugglers use [color=#9ef5ff]dead drops[/color], objects where the Phaethon Dynasty leaves notes with clues to the location of [color=#9c8245]drop pods[/color] filled with supplies.
Remember: - These are spread across the seedier points of interest across the sector. - Use any clue you might find lying around. - Ask around to see if the public's seen suspicious activity. - Be on the lookout for strange traffic patterns.
As TSFMC marines, part of your job is to prevent smuggling, and to prosecute anyone supporting the Phaethon Dynasty.
Do not allow the TSF's control of Colossus to waver, doing a poor job counter-smuggling will fund the Phaethon Dynasty Vanguard's insurgency.
## Notifications
When a note is taken from a [color=#9ef5ff]dead drop[/color], a [color=#9C8245]drop pod[/color] is teleported into the sector. This [color=#9C8245]drop pod[/color] contains Phaethon Dynasty supply crates, which the Sultanate is paying civilians to distribute.
With cutting-edge bluespace technology, [bold]we can get signatures when these notes are taken[/bold], and, with some delay, get [bold]the approximate location of a [color=#9c8245]drop pod[/color][/bold].
Due to the nature of bluespace, [bold]these notifications are not completely reliable[/bold], but that is no excuse for laziness. Remain vigilant.
## Forensics
A [color=#5d8c45]contraband forensics module[/color] comes standard in a TSF marine's uplink. [bold]Using these allows you to gather data from dead drops or drop pods and it will be translated into Federation Military Credits.[/bold].
[color=#5d8c45]Scanning[/color] active or previously used [color=#9ef5ff]dead drops[/color], and Phaethon Dynasty [color=#9c8245]drop pods[/color] credits the TSF's bank with credits and rewards the marine with FMC.
[bold]If you're first to a [color=#9ef5ff]dead drop[/color], you can intercept the supplies and bring them back to Halcyon for a much bigger reward, so get moving![/bold]
[bold]Remember to use any DNA you find to track down and prosecute the smugglers.[/bold] Those supporting the bloody massacre carried out by the Phaethon Dynasty must be brought to justice.
